output.question: Who is AWS's CTO?
output.answer: Werner Vogels is the CTO. His formal title is Vice President and Chief Technology Officer of Amazon.com, not a separate AWS-only post, but he is the CTO most associated with AWS. At AWS re:Invent in December 2025, he said he would stop giving his annual closing keynote but was not leaving Amazon. Wikipedia, last edited 1 November 2026, still lists him as Amazon's CTO and mentions no retirement or successor.

key_facts.fact: Werner Vogels is Amazon's chief technology officer and vice president, in charge of driving technology innovation within the company; he is listed as 'Werner Vogels (CTO)' among Amazon's current people.
At AWS re:Invent in December 2025, Vogels said he would no longer give his annual keynote but was not leaving Amazon.
The Wikipedia article, last edited 1 November 2026, mentions no retirement, departure or successor in 2026.

caveats: Vogels's formal title is CTO of Amazon.com, the parent company, not a separate AWS CTO post. Amazon has no widely reported standalone 'AWS CTO' role, but AWS has its own senior technology executives.
